newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-SIMPSON JOINS CHORUS CALLING FOR TAYLOR'S HEAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SIMPSON JOINS CHORUS CALLING FOR TAYLOR'S HEAD.

text.p: Bobby Simpson has become the third former Australian test captain to call on Mark Taylor to step down as skipper for the first test against England starting at Edgbaston on Thursday.
"Mark Taylor shouldn't even be thinking of playing," Simpson wrote in Wednesday's Daily Mail.
"I know Taylor is admired for his leadership, but that can't compensate for what is not just a bad run of form but a basic flaw in his technique.
"Even so close to the test, I still can't believe I will see him going out to bat."
Ian and Greg Chappell, two other former captains, have already called for Taylor's dismissal.
Simpson, the former Australian coach, said England had their best opportunity for a decade to beat the unofficial world champions.
But he said he still thought Australia would win the six-test series and retain the Ashes.
"The bowling attack has been tremendous over the past three years," Simpson said.
